title: Evidence Corpus Item
description: Machine-readable contract for a single evidence item in the Product Truth / Evidence Corpus

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence item

source.description: Where the evidence came from (URL, file path, interview ID, etc.)

source_tier.description: Primary = direct observation; Secondary = reported by others; Inferred = deduced from other evidence

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when evidence was collected or published

freshness.description: fresh = <6 months old; recent = 6-18 months; stale = >18 months

grade.description: Evidence grade: HIGH = direct/verifiable/recent; MEDIUM = secondary/somewhat dated; LOW = anecdotal/inferred/old

segment.description: Which customer segment this evidence relates to, or null if general

geography.description: Geographic market this evidence applies to, or null if global

bias.description: Potential biases affecting this evidence item

contradicts.description: IDs of other evidence items that this evidence contradicts

provenance.description: Full chain of how this evidence was obtained: who collected it, when, from what source, using what method

is_customer_commercial.description: True if evidence is from customer or commercial sources (user_quote, behavioral_observation, support_ticket, analytics_data, sales_data, pricing_signal)

content_summary.description: Brief summary of what the evidence says or shows

contradiction_notes.description: Explanation of any contradictions with other evidence items
